answer: Re-attestations are stored in plume and timber lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the gale graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 9 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 877 account sybil into a 12 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
